data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin for native OCR using Apple Vision on iOS and Google ML Kit on Android.
data.what_it_does: Provides optical character recognition (OCR) by leveraging native device frameworks. Processes images locally on-device to extract text without requiring an internet connection.
use_when: You need to extract text from local image files on iOS and Android.
You want on-device OCR processing without sending data to external servers.
avoid_when: You need to run OCR on unsupported platforms like Web or Desktop.
You require advanced OCR options like confidence scores or language hints out of the box.
strengths: On-device processing ensuring privacy and offline support.
Uses high-accuracy native frameworks (Apple Vision and Google ML Kit).
weaknesses: Limited platform support (only iOS and Android).
Minimal advanced configuration options currently available.
data.setup_notes: Requires Android configuration for compileSdk 35, minSdk 21, and Java 11 support, plus iOS 13.0 or later.

alternatives.name: google_mlkit_barcode_scanning
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you specifically need barcode scanning via Google ML Kit rather than general text recognition.
